answer: Proof-of-Personhood via social graph verification forces attackers to bridge the digital canyon between disparate identities. By requiring agents to exist on a verified terrace of human trust, the cost of generating identities exceeds the potential fable of a fake profit margin. Attackers must expend significant capital to mimic authentic social connections, rendering a large-scale Sybil expansion economically irrational compared to the inherent validation constraints of the network.
